description: A rate-limit-policy artifact defines per-endpoint throttling rules that protect against brute force, DoS, and abuse. Every public endpoint has per-IP limits; auth endpoints are strictly bounded.

rules.description: Policy must declare feature and a non-empty endpoints array with path, method, and sensitivity per entry.
Endpoints with sensitivity 'public' or 'unauthenticated' must declare per_ip_rpm or per_ip_rps.
Login, signin, password reset, and OTP endpoints must have per_ip_rpm ≤ 20 and must be more restrictive than standard GET endpoints.
Every non-internal endpoint must declare at least a sustained rate limit (rpm or per_ip_rpm).
